## About
Alamo Auto Sound & Security is a car audio and security shop at 1806 McCullough Ave in San Antonio. We install car stereo receivers, amps and speakers, Viper alarms, cameras, window tint and mounted lighting for security, school and construction vehicles.
Give us a call, tell us what you have in mind, and we can get you a price quote over the phone and set up a time to see your car. We hold a 4.6 rating from 167 Google reviews, and we would like to earn your business.

## Services
- Car stereo installation: Receivers, amps and speakers with the latest equipment, installed professionally.
- Viper alarms and cameras: Exclusive Viper alarms, plus cameras mounted wherever you need them.
- Emergency vehicle lights: Mounted lighting for security, school and construction vehicles.
- Window tinting: Window tint put on at our shop on McCullough Ave.
- Interlock service: One reviewer said we took the time to explain the interlock process from start to finish.

## FAQ
Q: When is the shop open?
A: Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I get a price?
A: Give the shop a call. We can give you a price quote over the phone and schedule your appointment.

Q: Do you tint windows on homes and businesses too?
A: Yes. Our window tint work covers automotive, residential and commercial.
